# Agent Plugins Skills

Shared agent skills maintained once in `agent-plugins/skills/` and generated into separate Claude and Codex plugin layouts.

## Existing Skills

This list is regenerated from `agent-plugins/skills/`.

- `code-review`: Pre-PR code review — find bugs, security issues, and logic errors in uncommitted changes, specific files, or a PR diff. Read-only, reports findings without fixing. Covers correctness, cross-method data flow, error handling, security, concurrency, architecture, performance, edge cases, tests.
- `stop-slop`: Remove AI writing patterns from prose. Use when drafting, editing, or reviewing text to eliminate predictable AI tells.
- `wrap-agent-skill`: Create Claude and Codex wrapper skills from canonical agent-plugins-skills skills in this repository. Use when asked to add, update, sync, or adapt `agent-plugins-skills/skills/<name>` into `codex/skills/<name>` and `.codex/skills/<name>` wrappers without duplicating the canonical skill body.

## Connect To Codex

Codex plugin manifest: `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` (version `0.1.0`).

1. Open Codex desktop.
2. Install or connect this repository as a local plugin from the repository root.
3. Confirm Codex reads `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`.
4. Codex skills are available from `codex/skills/`.

After changing canonical skills, regenerate wrappers with:

```bash
python scripts/generate_skill_wrappers.py --clean
```

## Connect To Claude

Claude plugin manifest: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` (version `0.2.0`).

1. Open Claude Code.
2. Add this repository as a local plugin from the repository root.
3. Confirm Claude reads `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
4. Claude skills are available from `claude/skills/`.

## Development

Edit skills only in `agent-plugins/skills/<skill-name>/`. The `claude/skills/` and `codex/skills/` trees are generated distribution copies.

The GitHub workflow in `.github/workflows/regenerate-skills.yml` regenerates all skills on push and commits generated updates when needed.
